department: Materials Science & Engineering Graduate Program (Texas Materials Institute)

deadline.value: All materials are due December 1 (2026) for Fall 2027; international applicants may send TOEFL/IELTS/DET scores until January 15. A spring intake has a September 15 deadline.
deadline.quote: International Students: ALL materials are due by December 1st. We will accept TOEFL/IELTS/DET until January 15th.

gre_general.value: The GRE is not required; scores are considered if you send them.
gre_general.quote: There is no GRE requirement for the MS&E program. However, if you want to send your GRE scores, UT Austin's code is 6882 and we will consider them along with the rest of your application during the decision process.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: Students are admitted directly into a lab: during admissions, applicants are matched with a recruiting faculty member and the offer comes from that supervisor. Contacting faculty before applying is not required but research fit matters.
supervisor.quote: Entering a graduate program with a faculty supervisor in place allows students to begin research immediately | when an admitted applicant receives an offer, it comes directly from a specific faculty member

also.quote: All of our students are "direct admits," meaning that all our students are matched with a supervisor and admitted directly into their labs.

funding.value: As a rule all students are supported (stipend, tuition and health insurance) via research or teaching assistantships or fellowships, contingent on progress and available funds; the program says almost all students have such a package.
funding.quote: This means, as a rule, all of our students are financially supported. | Financial support is contingent upon satisfactory progress twoard the degree and continued availability of funds.

also.quote: Almost all students in the program have a funding package of this quality.

entry_route.value: A bachelor's degree (or foreign equivalent) is enough; a master's is not required. The program admits PhD students almost exclusively.
entry_route.quote: A master's degree is not required to apply.

notes: Spring entry also possible (September 15 deadline). The program follows Graduate School English minimums (TOEFL 79, IELTS 6.5, DET 115).
